summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 38 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 10 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie posted a long, worth-reading thesis this week: the real battle in AI is becoming a battle for context. His view is that an agent's effectiveness comes down not to the model but to whether it has the right domain expertise, the right context and tools, and is embedded in a workflow users can review and hand off. So the platforms that capture and govern the best, most, and most relevant context—and pick the right model per task—become where agents do their best work. This, he argues, is why the a…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这周写了一段很值得云与 AI 落地团队细读的长论：AI 竞争的核心正在变成「上下文之争」（battle for context）。他的判断是——决定 agent 有效性的不是模型本身，而是 agent 是否拥有对的领域知识、对的上下文与工具、以及能否嵌入用户可复核、可交接的工作流。因此谁能在自己产品里捕获并治理住「最好、最多、最相关」的上下文，并为每个任务选对模型，谁就能成为 agent 真正干活的地方。他进一步说，这正是「应用 AI 层」远不止是 LLM 套壳的原因：把工作所需的关键知识组织起来、以受治理的方式维护（只有对的人和 agent 能访问）、并随时间持续改进 agent 的上下文，才是核心壁垒。长期看这一层会在模型之间做路由——用前沿模型做规划/编排/复核，用更便宜的开源或闭源小模型处理大批量中间任务，甚至自训领域专用模型。他还强调 FDE（前沿部署工程师）在应用层的关键性：这是客户具体业务问题被特定厂商端到端解决的落点，能完整做到端到端的公司护城河最深。

featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch surfaced a concept that is gaining traction—agentic self-improvement: give your agent the ability to introspect its past runs, spot inefficiencies, errors, and redundant tool calls, then produce new prompts and skills on its own. That, he notes, is why agent observability should be built in—it ships by default when you deploy on Vercel, so the agent has the data to iterate on itself. For teams productionizing agents, this is a practical signal: don't treat observability as an afterthough…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 抛出一个正在变热的概念——「agentic self-improvement」（智能体自我改进）：给 agent 内省自己历史运行记录的能力，让它自己发现低效环节、错误、冗余的工具调用，然后自动产出新的 prompt 和 skill。他借此点出为什么 agent 可观测性（observability）应该是内建的——在 Vercel 上部署时观测能力就是默认自带的，这样 agent 才有据可依地迭代自己。对做 agent 生产化的团队，这是一个很实用的信号：别把 observability 当事后补丁，它是自改进闭环的前提。

featured.title: Bryan Catanzaro（NVIDIA Nemotron 负责人）：NVIDIA 为什么免费送 AI 模型
featured.summaryEn: Intelligence will run "at the limit," so the only way to get more of it is to be more efficient, not to apply more force—this is the logic underlying NVIDIA's bets on open source, four-bit training, and hybrid architectures. Bryan Catanzaro leads NVIDIA's Nemotron family of open foundation models. Many don't realize NVIDIA runs a hundreds-strong frontier AI research effort—Nemotron 3 Ultra, released just weeks ago, immediately became the top US open-weights model. He dismisses the "who's catching whom" framing on the open-vs-closed gap: the whole field is moving so fast over any three-month window that field velocity matters more than any single-model gap. He sees three drivers for open source: real enterprise demand for deep customization, open collaboration simply being the fastest way to develop technology, and global (notably US-China) competition. Technically the episode is dense.…

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner and early Meter/Opendoor/Atlassian employee Nikunj Kothari offered a pragmatic take on the Gemini platform. He calls himself one of the more vocal critics of Gemini's product experience, yet admits it's still the only place where a single API key lets you do it all—Flash for fast, cheap, long-context structured tasks; Nano Banana for world-class images (the new lite model is great too); search with grounding; strong realtime audio on 3.1 Flash and now video with Omni. Many of his BYOK side pro…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人、Meter/Opendoor/Atlassian 早期员工 Nikunj Kothari 给了一段对 Gemini 平台很务实的评价。他自称是 Gemini 产品体验的直言批评者之一，但依然承认：Gemini 是唯一一个「单个 API key 就能全都干」的地方——Flash 做快速廉价的长上下文结构化任务、Nano Banana 提供世界级图像（新 lite 模型也很好）、带 grounding 的搜索、3.1 Flash 的实时音频以及 Omni 的视频能力等等。他很多 BYOK（自带 key）的 side project 都能简化成只带一个 Gemini key。对在做多模型选型的团队，这条是关于「单供应商覆盖广度」的一手体验。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder / Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Follow Builders author Zara Zhang shared a sharp observation on AI-era pricing: people are getting less willing to pay for a "tool"—because if it's just a tool, they figure they can build it themselves with coding agents. What they will pay for is the feeling of hiring expertise they don't have. It's a reminder for anyone building AI products, especially SaaS: raw features are being commoditized, and the value anchor has to shift from "a convenient tool" to "hard-to-replicate expertise or outcomes."
items.insightZh: Follow Builders 作者 Zara Zhang 这周有个关于「AI 时代产品定价」的敏锐观察：人们越来越不愿意为「工具」付费——因为如果只是个工具，他们觉得自己用 coding agent 就能造出来。他们真正愿意付费的，是「雇到自己不具备的专业能力」的那种感觉。这句话对所有做 AI 产品、尤其做 SaaS 的团队都是个提醒：单纯的功能正在被商品化，价值锚点要从「省事的工具」转向「难以复制的专业性/结果」。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic / Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's Thariq (Claude Code) shared his core methodology for working with AI coding tools (Fable): the most important part is discovering your own unknowns first, so you can prompt it better. He gave a concrete workflow, including using HTML artifacts to surface those unknowns, with runnable examples. The approach also underpinned his AI Engineer (AIE) talk, refined via a discussion with Geoffrey Litt that added quizzes to help clarify blind spots. For engineers using coding agents daily, it's a practical fram…
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 分享了他跟 AI 编码工具（Fable）协作的核心方法论：与 agent 协作最重要的一环，是先「发现自己的未知（unknowns）」，这样才能给出更好的 prompt。他给出了具体做法，还提到会用 HTML artifacts 来把这些未知点找出来，并配了可运行的示例。他这套方法也是他在 AI Engineer（AIE）大会演讲的基础，讲的时候还结合 Geoffrey Litt 的讨论加了「让 agent 出小测验帮你厘清盲区」的环节。对天天用 coding agent 的工程师，这是一个把「提问质量」系统化的实操框架。

items.title: Cat Wu · Anthropic / Claude Code + Cowork
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's Cat Wu (Claude Code + Cowork) shared a practical tip: you can use Claude Code with computer use to set up Claude Tag—just point it at the Claude Tag docs and it will connect your team's GitHub repo, data warehouse, Google Drive, and other data sources for you. For enterprise teams wanting to quickly wire an agent into internal data sources, it's a handy "let the agent configure the agent" path.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code + Cowork 的 Cat Wu 给了个实用的落地技巧：可以用 Claude Code 配合 computer use 来自动搭建 Claude Tag——只要把它指向 Claude Tag 文档，它就会自动帮你把团队的 GitHub 仓库、数据仓库、Google Drive 等数据源连起来。对企业里想快速把 agent 接到内部数据源的团队，这是个省事的「让 agent 自己配 agent」的路子。

items.title: Nan Yu · Linear 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Linear head of product Nan Yu left a striking note while resharing: if your field doesn't produce good training data, it was probably full of crap to begin with. It's a sharp lens on which kinds of work AI will really absorb—data quality partly reflects how structured and genuinely valuable the work itself is. In another post he framed the ideal for medical AI: the best scenario isn't AI replacing doctors, but a doctor who spends significant time on your case and is equipped with LLMs.
items.insightZh: Linear 产品负责人 Nan Yu 转发时留了句很有意思的观察：如果一个领域产不出好的训练数据，那它「一开始大概率就是一堆糊弄事」。这是一个关于「哪些工作会被 AI 真正吃掉」的犀利视角——数据质量某种程度上反映了这项工作本身的结构化与真实价值。他另一条也点了医疗 AI 的理想形态：最好的场景不是 AI 取代医生，而是一个愿意在你的病例上花大量时间、同时又配备了 LLM 的医生。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw / OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw's "ClawFather" Peter Steinberger shared a practical tip for design with Codex: if you think Codex sucks at design, try the prompt "use imagegen to re-imagine this design and implement that." The idea is to let the coding agent generate a visual reference via an image model first, then implement against it—routing around the aesthetic weakness of a text-only agent. A directly copyable trick for anyone doing frontend/UI with coding agents.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw「ClawFather」Peter Steinberger 给了个关于 Codex 做设计的实用技巧：如果你觉得 Codex 在设计上很烂，试试这句 prompt——"use imagegen to re-imagine this design and implement that"（用图像生成重新构想这个设计并把它实现出来）。核心思路是让编码 agent 先借图像模型生成视觉参考，再据此落地实现，绕开纯文本 agent 在视觉审美上的短板。对用 coding agent 做前端/UI 的人是个可以直接抄的招。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / Cognition
items.summaryEn: Latent Space and Cognition's Swyx offered a sharp irony on how AI tool form factors are evolving: the "tools for thought" crowd spent nearly a decade making pretty canvas demos, only to get completely mogged by low-contrast, poorly designed CLIs—simply because CLIs do the commoditized thinking for you. It's a pointed reminder about AI product form: flashy visual interfaces don't necessarily win; plain tools that actually do the cognitive labor for users can prevail.
items.insightZh: Latent Space、Cognition 的 Swyx 抛了个关于 AI 工具形态演变的犀利反讽："tools for thought"（思维工具）那帮人花了近十年做各种漂亮的画布（canvas）演示，结果被「低对比度、设计粗糙的命令行（CLI）」彻底碾压——就因为 CLI 能替你「做商品化的思考」。这是对当下 AI 产品形态的一个尖锐提醒：华丽的可视化交互未必赢，真正替用户完成认知劳动的朴素工具反而胜出。
